title: The beer sign in a puddle
logline: The tavern's beer sign in a puddle in the alley, October rain, the Rain Sunday's first tier as a private page, without the Sunday. The garage window's light in the same puddle, at the edge.

panels.composition: A puddle in a gravel alley in October rain reflecting a tavern's beer sign's neon, and at the puddle's edge the reflected light of a small lit window.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a puddle in a gravel alley in October rain reflecting a tavern's neon beer sign and at its edge the reflected light of a small lit window, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
